title: CCS Researching Reality Internship 2027
summary: Eight-week, full-time public-policy research internship at the Centre for Civil Society, ending in a capstone project.
eligibility: Students or recent graduates in economics, public policy or a related social science, with strong research, quantitative and English/Hindi writing skills.
notes: The 2026 edition ran 1 June–31 July and its applications closed on 5 April 2026.
